chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Isma'il ibn Riyah, who said:
I asked Aba al-Hasan عليه السلام about one performing the standalone 'umrah: is the tawaf al-nisa' obligatory upon him? He said: Yes.

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: the Imam addressed in the narration
key_terms.طَوَافُ النِّسَاءِ: the tawaf specifically required in relation to the permissibility of marital relations after the rite
key_terms.نَعَمْ: an affirmative legal answer meaning yes

ai.seo_question: Is tawaf al-nisa' obligatory in standalone 'umrah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the standalone 'umrah. It states that tawaf al-nisa' is obligatory for the person performing this form of 'umrah, establishing an important rule within the rites of hajj-related worship.
